title: feat(plugin-list)!: the renderers stop reading the list-view keys every door refuses (objectui#6152, round 14)
body:
Part of #6152 (round 14). This card stays open for the next round, the legacy chart binding (class D of the round-13 census).

Clause-②: no

The renderers stop reading the list-view keys every door already refuses. Rounds 11 and 12 closed the doors (`@object-ui/types`, `objectui validate`, the spec's view write door). The readers stayed, so a stored row still rendered as written. This round retires them on every route the round-13 census (report 6077447919) named, under the seat's answer 6077535247 (Q2 → A, Q1 → C). Authority: the startup-transition clause, 「废弃别名/拼写与能力退役默认**立即退休**,无分阶段窗口、无双拼写宽限;staged 仅凭具名外部用户证据方可荐」. Production stores are NOT MEASURED; the changeset says so and gives the FROM → TO a surviving row needs.

## What retires, per class and route

| class | what | where |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| A, alias rungs | `kanban.groupField` / `cardFields`, `gallery.imageField`, `timeline.dateField`, and `calendar.dateField` read as a timeline axis, in both nestings | the core fold `normalizeListViewSchema` (`PER_VIEW_CONFIG_ALIASES`, its collection, its early-return term, its loop, its docblock bullet); `ListView`'s kanban / gallery branches, capability gate and `resolveTimelineDateBinding`; app-shell's `kanbanViewOptions` / `galleryViewOptions` / `timelineViewOptions`; plugin-view's `generateViewSchema`; `ObjectTimeline`'s nested `timeline.dateField` rung and its entry in the refusal's key list |
| B, objectui-only capabilities on refused keys | `calendar.defaultView`'s lift; the `...restKanban` / `...restCalendar` spreads | `ListView`, `generateViewSchema`. The declared keys those spreads also carried are now read by name: kanban `summarizeField`, calendar `colorField` / `allDayField` |
| C, other spreads and the tree label alias | `tree.titleField`; the tree, gantt and `options.grid` spreads; plugin-view's raw gallery / timeline / gantt spreads | `ListView`, app-shell's tree relay, `generateViewSchema`. Gantt goes through a typed TOTAL table of the spec block's keys (`GANTT_CONFIG_SPELLING`, `satisfies Record` over `keyof` the spec type), and plugin-view's timeline through the same shape |
| E, projection collectors | `groupField`, `groupBy`, `cardTitle`, `dateField`, `endField`, `imageField`, `swimlaneField`, `valueField`, `cardFields` | both `ListView` collectors (`expandFields` and its `$select` twin) |
| F, prose | the refusal sentences and the "did not move" blocks; the kanban `groupBy` refusal no longer suggests the refused `groupField` | `objectql.zod.ts`, `packages/types/src/zod/README.md`, the docblocks beside each reader, and dated notes on `.changeset/6152-list-view-blocks-strict.md`, `.changeset/6152-list-view-options-bag.md` and (patch 1) `.changeset/6152-object-calendar-container-strict.md` |

⛔ Not in this round: class D, the legacy chart binding (`resolveListChartBinding`'s legacy half and `ListView`'s legacy chart branch); `inlineEditOffered`; app-shell's `onInlineEditChange` / `persistViewPatch` path; any door or schema shape in `packages/types`.

The core leg was parked behind PR objectui#12036 at dispatch. It landed during this round (`3c3115e`), so `origin/main` was merged in (a merge commit, no rebase) and the core leg is in this PR. Nothing is parked. Its four shared files keep its work intact: this diff, read against `3c3115e`, changes no line that names `inlineEdit`, `editInline`, `foldsInlineEditIntoEditInline`, `keepInlineEditModeForTheSession`, `onInlineEditChange` or `persistViewPatch`.

One typing note. `ListView`'s `viewComponentSchema` memo was `any` by INFERENCE: the tree branch spread an untyped block, and one `any` member made the union `any`. Retiring that spread exposed it, so the memo now states `(): any` openly, the same type, as plugin-view's `generateViewSchema` already does. Measured: without the annotation `tsc` refuses the union at the `SchemaRenderer` hand-off (TS2322).

## Fixtures, re-judged (H1)

The census's lists were candidates. The instrument was a run of every test file that imports or names a touched module, plus the census's candidates: 16 existing arms went red before the merge, the arms that held only through the core fold flipped with the core leg, and a `git grep` per removed rung found the arms that stayed green for the wrong reason.

- **Replaced** (their subject, the alias read, is gone; each now pins that the stored alias binds nothing): plugin-list `galleryOptionsBagCanonical-6152`, `kanbanOptionsBagCanonical-8193` (bag and top-level arms), `timeline-binding` (three arms), `strayGroupByRefused-8365`, `ListView.test` (the `groupField` alias arm), `calendarAliasRefused-8355` (the renderer-ahead knob control); app-shell `galleryBinding-7547`, `timelineBinding`, `titleFieldConvergence` (the tree `titleField` rung); plugin-view `strayGroupByLane-9242` (the alias control and the passthrough control), `timelineBinding-7070`; plugin-timeline `timeline-date-binding`, `absentDateAxisRefusal-7459`; console `timelineAxisRefusalReach-7070` (both faces, both nestings); plugin-calendar `calendarUnionReads-8651` (the producer ledger); types `object-kanban-group-by-limit-7322` (the view-level alias source pin, core included) and `tree-view-config-readers-8253`; core `normalize-list-view.test` (the eleven fold cases become seven: passthrough, by-reference, a fold that still runs, and the four boundary cases).
- **Green for the wrong reason, replaced:** app-shell `kanbanLane-8193` and `kanbanGroupByRetired-8213` wrote `groupField: 'stage'` on an object whose detector also picks `stage`, so they could not tell a read alias from an ignored one; they now write a value the detector never picks.
- **Re-spelled** (the alias was only the spelling): `speculativeFls-7216` PIN 4 (the FLS gate on the timeline start binding), `timeline-binding`'s precedence case, `timelineMetaFieldsRetired-10222`'s firing control (`visibleFields`, a key the collectors still read), app-shell `calendarBinding-7029` (its "fully declared" block carried `defaultView`).
- Door pins in `packages/types` assert refusal and did not flip.

## New pins

- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.readersRetired-6152.test.tsx`, on the node `ListView` generates: (1) the K8 hazard, a block key named like a node key (`objectName`) no longer overrides the node, on the kanban, calendar, gantt, tree and grid branches, each with a lit control that the block was read; (2) the declared keys keep their route: `summarizeField`, `colorField` / `allDayField`, and every gantt key, driven off the spec's own shape, block winning over bag per key; (3) each retired key reaches nothing, beside a control in the same position; (4) the top-level spellings the core fold used to rewrite; H2, below.
- `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.readersRetired-6152.test.tsx`, the same three on `generateViewSchema`'s node, with gantt and timeline driven off the spec's shapes.

## Measurements

- **H2 holds.** The node `ListView` builds for `gallery.coverField` (top-level and bag) has no flat `imageField`, and the REAL `ObjectGallery` draws the cover from it; the retired bag `imageField` draws none. On plugin-view's route the flat `imageField` stays (that route hands `ObjectGallery` no nested block), read from `coverField` only.
- **H3 holds.** The gantt spreads became the spec block's declared keys through a typed total table; the K8 hazard is pinned on every narrowed branch of both routes.
- **H4 fits.** Eager closure (`apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, both builds under `os-verify-lock`): `main` 3c3115e 3,239,495 B gzipped, this PR at de08bfa 3,239,666 B, delta **+171 B**, headroom 41,801 B to `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` (untouched). Before the merge the same instrument read +411 B against 8de8ba2, before the core leg freed its share. `pnpm check:eager-closure` exits 0 at the head.

## Ablations (each through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, restore proven by blob hash against HEAD)

- A1, drop `timeSegments` from `GANTT_CONFIG_SPELLING`: `tsc` red, TS1360. The first attempt was a no-op the tool refused (its replacement text was already in the file), so it was re-anchored and re-run.
- A1b, add an undeclared `swimlaneField` to the table: `tsc` red, TS2353.
- A2, re-add the raw `options.kanban` spread after the kanban node's keys: the K8 kanban arm red, and the bag `cardFields` arm red too (the spread carried it back). Predicted the first only; observed both.
- A3, restore `?? s.dateField` in `resolveTimelineDateBinding`: the four-source arm and the bag-alias arm red.
- A4, restore plugin-view's raw timeline spread: the K8 timeline arm and the declared-keys timeline arm red.
- A5, restore a `kanban.groupField` fold at the head of `normalizeListViewSchema`: four arms red (the core by-reference arm and its control, the top-level kanban arm, the top-level gate arm). Predicted the core passthrough arm too; it stayed green, because its fixture also carries `groupByField`, which the ablated fold skips.

## Gates

Patch 1 (`0ad881d`, the seat's answer to the round's one question) adds one dated note to `.changeset/6152-object-calendar-container-strict.md` and nothing else: no source or test file changes, so the battery, the builds, `type-check`, ESLint and the bundle reading below stand as measured at `de08bfa`, and only the changeset and text gates were re-run at `0ad881d` (all exit 0, listed in the last bullet).

- Tests at de08bfa, under `os-verify-lock`, from the repo root: every test file that imports or names a touched module (relative importers and the `@object-ui/plugin-list` / `plugin-view` / `plugin-timeline` package importers), every test file this PR changes, the `normalize-list-view*` suites and the whole `scripts/__tests__/` suite: 588 files, `Test Files 586 passed | 2 skipped (588)`, `Tests 14141 passed | 14 skipped (14155)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The `@object-ui/core` package importers (most of the repo) were not enumerated; the suites that exercise `normalizeListViewSchema` through `ListView` and `ObjectView` are in the set, and CI runs the rest.

- `type-check` (script name echoed) exit 0 for `@object-ui/types`, `core`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-view`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-calendar`, `app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, on the dependency closure built at de08bfa.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) on the 31 changed TS files: 0 errors. Warnings: the modified files are unchanged against `main` (541 → 541); the two new test files add 12 `no-explicit-any` warnings from the house node-capture harness. The config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project`), so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide run is CI's.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `-no-major`, `-fixed`, `-claims`, `-overwrite` (at `de08bfa` it reported the two dated notes then present, case 2, declarations unchanged), `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-doc-links`: all exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED. Re-run at `0ad881d` after patch 1, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `-no-major`, `-fixed`, `-overwrite` (three dated notes, declarations unchanged), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new).

## Acceptance notes (not fixed here)

- plugin-view's own route never honoured a declared gallery `coverFit`, `cardSize` or `visibleFields`: `generateViewSchema` flattens the block, and `ObjectGallery` reads those keys only nested. Measured on `main` and on this branch with the real `ObjectGallery` (`coverFit: 'contain'` draws `object-cover` on both; the same block nested draws `object-contain`). Unchanged by this round; reported to the seat.
- The development-only flat-key warnings (`generateViewSchema`, app-shell's object page) still list `dateField`, `groupField`, `imageField` and `cardFields` and tell an author to move them into the block, where every door now refuses them. Reported to the seat.
- plugin-view's kanban branch still reads `kanban.conditionalFormatting` by name (host `views` entries); the census did not classify it, and it is not in this round.

Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is the seat's, after this report.
